_comment: Regression gate rules for compare_baseline.py. A metric regresses when
it moves in the bad direction by more than max(abs, rel * |baseline|).
Metrics not listed here are reported but never fail the gate.
Timing tolerances are deliberately wider than accuracy tolerances:
the audit measured single-tick outliers of 2x on a loaded laptop, and
the gate must not fail on machine noise. Tighten them once the Linux
container runs are the only gated environment.

replay.memory_growth_mb_total is deliberately not gated: over a 120 s replay it mostly measures the rolling window filling from 5 s to 30 s, and natively the preceding offline pass is still releasing memory, so the number can even be negative. Peak RSS is gated; leaks are the soak harness's job (benchmark_diarization_soak).

Phase 2a adds the label-latency and diarization-cost metrics (caption.on.label.*, caption.on.diarization.*). They are gated against the baseline once a Phase 2a baseline is committed; before that they are SKIPPED (missing on the baseline side) and acceptance.py checks their absolute targets.

Phase 2b adds the end-of-stream and overlap-aware DER views, the speaker-count-within-one fraction, revisions and merges. end_of_stream and speaker count are gated; the overlap-aware views, revisions and merges are informational.

Phase 2c: labels per speaker is gated two-sided through replay.labels_per_speaker_deviation (|mean ratio - 1|); the raw ratio stays informational. The speaker-count fractions use reference speakers with >= 5 s of speech. The classroom case (classroom.*) is gated on the fraction of questions that get their own label.

Phase 2 wrap-up: the gated speaker-count metrics are the ones a viewer sees, replay.speaker_count_settled_within_1_fraction, replay.speaker_count_settled_exact_fraction and replay.labels_settled_per_speaker_deviation (labels on settled captions per reference speaker, distance from 1): a label the fragment fold removes before its captions settle appears in the minted and used counts but never on screen. The minted/used-based metrics (labels_per_speaker_deviation, speaker_count_within_1_fraction, speaker_count_exact_fraction) stay in the report for information. session_labels_merged now counts folds too and is informational; classroom.labels_per_person_settled is gated.

Phase 2c production readiness: replay.offline.* may come from a whole-file pass recorded natively and re-scored inside the container run (run_suite --offline-from <report written with --keep-hypotheses>); the report says so in replay.config.offline_from and per file in offline.source. The pass is deterministic for a given model, audio and pyannote version, so the gate compares the values like any other.
